body:
**Tier: T4**
**Why:** program delivery now runs inside the purchase / $0 invite-grant / free-claim fan-out transaction (a defect there blocks clinic clients from getting access), and the migration adds `ON DELETE CASCADE` from `User` (account deletion removes the client's program copies).
**T4 trigger scan:** (1) entitlement/package-grant delivery path (`WorkoutAssetResolver` inside `PurchaseFanoutService.onPurchaseEntitled`, which `InviteGrantService.deliver` and paid checkout call); (2) deletion semantics (new FK `WorkoutProgram.client_id -> User ON DELETE CASCADE`); (3) bulk writes across many clients (bulk assign) and a destructive coach action (unassign deletes not-started assignments). No auth/RLS policy change, no secrets, no fee math, no CI gate files.
**T3 trigger scan:** shared contract change: `workout_program` package content `asset_id` now means a master `WorkoutProgram` id (it already did for the regimes list; authoring and delivery checked `WorkoutPlan`); idempotency semantics across components (unique `delivery_key`).
**Bounded T1:** NO (cross-subsystem, migration, money-adjacent delivery path).
**Builder/owner:** S-MWB-111 (Claude Opus 5.5 builder lane), operator agent 111.
**Acceptance evidence:** targeted jest (below), `tsc --noEmit` clean, R75 banned-cast checker `--mode=range` OK. Customer outcome: a coach builds a program once, assigns it to many clients from a start date, and adds it to a package so every client who joins (paid or $0 grant) receives the whole program from day 1.
**Promotion triggers:** already T4.

Migration prefix `20270223000000` confirmed by the operator (09:53 PDT).

## What this adds (true gaps only; June MWB routes, guards and services are reused unchanged)

| Gap | Change |
|---|---|
| G1 no library API | `ProgramLibraryController` at `/api/v1/coach/programs` behind FEATURE_MWB_TEMPLATES (`ProgramLibraryFeatureGuard`: 404 `programs_unavailable` when off), `@Roles('coach','owner')`. |
| G2 clone probe per coach, not per client | New per-client copy path (`ProgramDeliveryService`) keyed by a UNIQUE `delivery_key`; the June `clone-to-client` route is untouched (not used by mobile). |
| G3 program as package asset | `assertAssetOwnedByCoach('workout_program')` accepts a live, non-empty master `WorkoutProgram` of the tenant (`program_archived` / `program_empty` 422 otherwise; legacy plan ids still accepted). `WorkoutAssetResolver` delivers the whole program when `asset_id` is a master program (in the ambient fan-out tx when present; own tx on the cron path); `materialisedRef` = first assignment id so the client's deliverables row opens day 1. |
| G4 bulk assign | `POST /:id/assign {client_ids[1..50], start_date YYYY-MM-DD, allow_repeat?}` + Idempotency-Key. One transaction per client (isolated failures), advisory lock per (master, client), per-client result `assigned` (with `replayed`) / `already_assigned` (`program_already_assigned`) / `failed` (`not_your_client`, `client_not_found`, `program_empty`, or `assign_failed` with a support reference + Sentry). One push per newly assigned client. |
| G5 saved-workout reuse | `GET /saved-workouts` (standalone plans only), `PUT /:id/days/:w/:d {source: saved_workout, plan_id}` copies it into a day. |

Routes: `GET /` (q, goal_tag, status=active|archived, cursor), `GET /saved-workouts`, `POST /`, `GET /:id` (grid + packages), `PATCH /:id` (`expected_version`; `program_version_conflict`, `program_days_out_of_range`), `PUT /:id/days/:w/:d` (blank | saved_workout | copy_day; `program_day_filled`, `program_day_out_of_range`), `DELETE /:id/days/:w/:d` (`program_in_package_needs_a_day` guard), `POST /:id/duplicate`, `POST /:id/archive` (`program_in_package`), `POST /:id/restore`, `GET /:id/revisions`, `GET /:id/assignees`, `POST /:id/assign`, `DELETE /:id/assignees/:clientId`.

Grid semantics match the June `assignProgramToClient`: a day is scheduled at start + (week_index x 7 + day_index) days, so each week has seven day slots; `days_per_week` stays the training-days target shown on the card. Bulk-assign start dates are anchored at 12:00 UTC so the calendar day is stable for clients in UTC-11..UTC+11. Package delivery starts at the drop's fire time.

Assigned count = distinct clients with assignments on live copies, so pre-existing copies (MWB-2 clone, #607 onboarding copies without `client_id`) count too.

#607 compatibility: no change to `workout-builder.service.ts` (which #607 reformats); #607 masters appear in the library like any master. Follow-up once #607 merges: refuse archiving a master referenced by `ClinicProgramSet`.

Sub-coaches: may read tenant-shared programs and assign to clients in scope; editing day workouts in the June builder still requires the head coach (`getPlan` checks `plan.coach_id === caller`), unchanged here.

## Migration `20270223000000_mwb_program_delivery`
Additive: `WorkoutProgram.client_id TEXT NULL` (FK `User(id)` ON DELETE CASCADE), `delivery_key TEXT NULL` UNIQUE, index `(cloned_from_id, client_id, archived_at)`. No backfill, no RLS change (WorkoutProgram policies are row-level; clients never read WorkoutProgram). SQL generated from `prisma migrate diff` between the base and new schema, then made idempotent (`IF NOT EXISTS`, guarded FK). `down.sql` drops exactly those objects.

## Tests (targeted, `--runInBand`, via heavy.sh)
`npx jest --runInBand test/mwb-program-delivery.service.spec.ts test/mwb-program-library.service.spec.ts test/mwb-program-package-delivery.spec.ts test/assignable-asset-resolver-workout.spec.ts test/roles-enforced.spec.ts test/mwb-templates-feature.guard.spec.ts test/purchase-fanout-real-body.spec.ts test/package-contents.service.spec.ts` -> all pass (57 + 80).
`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` -> exit 0. `node scripts/check-r75.js --mode=range --base=origin/main --head=HEAD` -> OK.
Live-DB behaviour (advisory locks, unique key race, cascade) is covered by CI's live suites only through schema parity; no new live spec in this PR (sandbox cannot run Postgres).

## Flags / env
No new env names. Backend manifest entries needed (#637): `FEATURE_MWB_TEMPLATES=true` (library + bulk assign), `FEATURE_MWB_AUTOSAVE_UNDO=true` + `MWB_AUTOSAVE_LOCK_TOKEN_SECRET` (secret, 32+ bytes) for builder autosave/undo, `FEATURE_NAMED_REGIMES=true` (promote to regime). Package delivery of programs does not depend on any flag (a sold package keeps delivering if a flag is turned off).

| Finding | Change | Commit | Proof |
|---|---|---|---|
| (none yet) | | | |
